entries.title: Configure step starts in absent directory
entries.root_cause: The workflow sets the configure step working directory to out/sonar-build, but no preceding step creates that directory. The workflow must create it before starting the step or use an existing directory.

entries.title: Configure directory still absent
entries.root_cause: The workflow sets the configure step working directory to out/sonar-build, but no preceding step creates that directory. The workflow must create it before starting the step or use an existing directory.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request uses a different runner and checkout path, with dependency setup and a different configure command before the same process launch failure.

entries.title: Sonar executable cannot link pulse function
entries.root_cause: The sonar executable calls pulse::estimate_delay, but the CMake target omits the source file defining that function. Add the implementation source to the linked target.

entries.title: Undefined pulse function on link
entries.root_cause: The sonar executable calls pulse::estimate_delay, but the CMake target omits the source file defining that function. Add the implementation source to the linked target.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run uses a different build configuration and parallelism, and debug information reports the source line of the reference.
